description: Escort a freighter who is carrying modified blasters safely to Prime.

values: Escort a freighter who is carrying modified blasters safely to Prime.

children.key: a merchant captain is searching for escort to Prime, in the Betelgeuse system, you have no idea what they are doing on a pirate world. From what you understand, they are transporting Modified blasters, they'll pay 100,000 credits
(Go find some other work to do.)

values: You have reached <planet>, but you left the Blonde Mermaid behind ! Better depart and wait for them to arrive in this star system.
you land on Prime and the merchant captain pays you 100,000 credits. "Thank you captain, with these blasters, we will make a new weapon."

children.key: You hear that some Navy captains have gone nuts and are saying that something important is hidden in the Orbona system, they call themselves the Truthseekers, and they attack anyone who enters Orbona.

name: Pirate Weapon Testing
description: Haven's Engineers asked you to protect their freighter and destroy any pirate attacking it.

values: Haven's Engineers asked you to protect their freighter and destroy any pirate attacking it.

children.key: As you are walking through the spaceport, someone call you "You're a captain, right ? we're engineers, and we want to test our new equipement. we have a fleet already equipped, and we'll test it by lurring in other pirates with a freighter, and having our fleet destroy them with our weapons. even if we have a strong fleet, we're looking for help, just  in case. we'll pay you <payment>, if you accept, protect the freighter and help the fleet destroy any agressive pirate."

values: you make it back to the engineers, they pay you <payment>, they tell you they plan to start selling their equipement in a week or two
